description: This file defines the Context struct and related methods for managing request context, including localization, session info, logging, and request metadata in the Mattermost server project.

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Struct encapsulating request-specific data such as localization, session, request metadata, and logging.

methods.name: NewContext
methods.description: Creates a new Context with provided request details and translation function.

methods.name: EmptyContext
methods.description: Creates an empty Context with a default logger.

methods.name: TestContext
methods.description: Creates a test Context with a new logger for testing purposes.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the Context.

methods.name: T
methods.description: Translates a message ID with optional arguments.

methods.name: GetT
methods.description: Returns the translation function.

methods.name: Session
methods.description: Returns the session associated with the context.

methods.name: RequestId
methods.description: Returns the request ID.

methods.name: IPAddress
methods.description: Returns the IP address.

methods.name: XForwardedFor
methods.description: Returns the X-Forwarded-For header value.

methods.name: Path
methods.description: Returns the request path.

methods.name: UserAgent
methods.description: Returns the user agent string.

methods.name: AcceptLanguage
methods.description: Returns the accepted language.

methods.name: Logger
methods.description: Returns the logger interface.

methods.name: Context
methods.description: Returns the underlying context.Context.

methods.name: WithT
methods.description: Returns a new Context with a different translation function.

methods.name: WithSession
methods.description: Returns a new Context with a different session.

methods.name: WithRequestId
methods.description: Returns a new Context with a different request ID.

methods.name: WithIPAddress
methods.description: Returns a new Context with a different IP address.

methods.name: WithXForwardedFor
methods.description: Returns a new Context with a different X-Forwarded-For header.

methods.name: WithPath
methods.description: Returns a new Context with a different request path.

methods.name: WithUserAgent
methods.description: Returns a new Context with a different user agent.

methods.name: WithAcceptLanguage
methods.description: Returns a new Context with a different accepted language.

methods.name: WithContext
methods.description: Returns a new Context with a different underlying context.

methods.name: WithLogger
methods.description: Returns a new Context with a different logger.

methods.name: WithLogFields
methods.description: Returns a new Context with additional log fields.

methods.name: With
methods.description: Applies a function to modify the Context and returns the result.
